payload.reason: The evidence indicates that RR-based fingerprint construction is crucial for improving the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in detection models. Without it, the ability to isolate the real-world forced response from internal variability would be compromised, leading to lower SNR and potentially less reliable results.

claims.text: RR-based fingerprint construction improves the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) by relying on regions with smaller but more robust changes for forced response prediction.
Without RR, the detection model may struggle to isolate the real-world forced response from internal variability, leading to lower SNR.
